result.title: Learning from high-resolution 2D images to reconstruct 3D microstructures
result.summary: High-resolution three-dimensional (3D) microstructure characterization remains difficult to undertake at scale because volumetric imaging at the required spatial resolution is expensive, time-consuming or destructive. In many settings, however, fine-resolution two-dimensional (2D) imaging and lower-resolution volumetric measurements are both readily available. We introduce a Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation (PCRD) framework that leverages fine-resolution 2D observations during training to improve specimen-specific 3D reconstruction from lower-resolution volumetric imaging alone. We demonstrate PCRD on pultruded carbon fiber-reinforced polymer composites, using scanning electron microscopy as the privileged modality and micro-CT as the inference input. The framework transfers spatial organization by matching similarity distributions defined around corresponding spatial anchors in the teacher and student representations, avoiding direct alignment of heterogeneous feature vectors. In 2D cross-sectional reconstruction, PCRD improves mAP by 1.66 percentage points over direct micro-CT training. Independent 3D validation against high-resolution synchrotron X-ray CT data shows close agreement in fiber volume fraction, diameter and local spacing. The PCRD reconstruction matches 89.97% of the reference fiber centerline length, compared with 75.08% for the interpolated low-resolution volume.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究如何用高分辨率2D显微图像作为训练期特权模态、仅以低分辨率体成像为输入，重建样品特定的3D微观结构；提出 Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation（PCRD），通过匹配教师与学生表示中围绕对应空间锚点的相似度分布来迁移空间组织信息，避免异构特征向量的直接对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以空间锚点为中心的相似度分布匹配」是一种跨模态关系蒸馏监督，可能为 LVR 中如何在不直接对齐异构表示的前提下监督 latent 状态、以及 latent 相似度结构（位置与内容因素）提供可供核查的线索，但属材料表征领域，迁移性需较多验证。
